item.description:
Office of the New York City Comptroller Mark Levine 1
During the first three quarters of FY 2026, the City collected $108.489 billion in revenues and incurred $110.161 billion in expenditures, for a net shortfall of $1.672 billion. Total revenues increased 2.8%, or $2.922 billion, compared to the same period last fiscal year, while expenditures rose 8%, or $8.153 billion. The largest factor behind weaker receipts was the anticipated drop in COVID -related funding.…
